verdict.comment: This is all about FOREST SPIRIT (nap), who escapes a penalty for Saturday's 5l win in an apprentice handicap at Southwell.

comments.aikhal: His mark continues to tumble but he's finished down the field on all three runs this year
comments.cloudsiderock: Only fifth over C&D on last month's handicap debut but may improve for that run
comments.dibbledabble: Below par when last seen but a break may have helped and she's on a competitive mark
comments.forestspirit: Escapes a penalty for Saturday's 5l win in an apprentice handicap at Southwell
comments.harrythehaggler: Won at Southwell last month; not quite at same level since but may be able to bounce back
comments.missapplejack: Bumper and handicap hurdle winner who is not ruled out in her first Flat handicap
comments.pysanka: All four wins have come over C&D but hasn't really threatened over C&D on last three runs
comments.silkbird: Tailed off on her three runs for a new yard this winter, following a long absence
comments.starfighter: Two C&D wins in January and close second over C&D last time; solid claims

races.raceComment: harrythehaggler is marginally preferred with a score of 58.3%, holding clear edges in superior course form and more reliable profile over pysanka. Won 1 of last 6 starts, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.
